messages:
alex_support: Heads-up: GammaHealth just opened an escalated ticket. After an IdP metadata update yesterday ~11:30 UTC they report ~120 users missing from our org and duplicate accounts created via SCIM. Also seeing sudden invoice jump. Customer is worried about data retention of deprovision events and whether any PII was stored unencrypted.

jordan_sre: ack. Do we have a repro or logs yet?

alex_support: I pulled their support bundle. SCIM returned a series of 403s for the /Users endpoint around 11:31-11:34, then a flood of POSTs creating accounts that look like re-creations. Sample log snippet: 
```
2026-03-12T11:31:02Z WARN scim: 403 unauthorized - missing claim 'sub' from SAML assertion for user j.smith@gammahealth.com
2026-03-12T11:31:12Z INFO scim: POST /Users created user id=u_9f3b... source=provisioner
```

matt_idp: That 403 smells like the IdP removed the NameID attribute in the metadata change. We did advise them to keep NameID or map a persistent id. Did they change NameID format?

alex_support: Customer says they updated certificate + made minor attribute mapping tweaks. They insisted it was just cert rotation.

iris_sec: tagging in security. Two quick asks: (1) Did any archived deprovision events contain cleartext PII that could violate retention policy? (2) KMS/HSM: were those artifacts encrypted with customer-specific key or platform key? Customer is asking for audit evidence.

jordan_sre: We store SCIM payloads in the audit-log stream for 90 days, encrypted at rest with platform KMS. Need to confirm envelope keys for that tenant.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-05T02:12:00Z - scim-service v2.14.1 rolled to prod. No config changes since.

matt_idp: Quick repro steps for IdP team: ask GammaHealth to re-enable NameID in SAML assertion or map 'persistent-id' to 'sub'. Meanwhile I'll request their IdP SAML traces.

iris_sec: I'll run a quick audit on the retention buckets. If anything was retained beyond SLA we'll need a formal incident and notification. Also want to know whether the SCIM audit entries contain unredacted attributes (like SSN) — they shouldn't.

alex_support: Customer also reports billing spike — looks like duplicate accounts triggered usage-based charges for embeddings/requests. Need billing & product to weigh in on credits while we triage.

jordan_sre: On the duplication: sounds like race between deprovision (403) and re-provision POSTs. We should look at the queueing/backoff logic in the scim worker. I'll grep the worker logs for "conflict" or "existing user" churn.

iris_sec: For KMS: tenant GammaHealth is using platform-managed KMS (not customer key). I'll pull the key rotation logs and CMK usage for the time window. If any exports occurred we need to capture that context.

matt_idp: Suggest temporary mitigation: set SCIM to strict mode on their org (reject create if assertion missing sub) and pause auto-provisioning for 30m. Customer can approve the change.

alex_support: I requested permission to pause provisioning; they said yes. Also asked billing for a provisional credit.

jordan_sre: Quick config pointers I sent to alpha: ```scim.worker.max_retries=3
scim.create_on_missing=false
```

iris_sec: Next steps for sec: (A) confirm encryption envelope and that logs only contain hashed identifiers, (B) produce audit export for 11:00-12:00 UTC showing access to SCIM artifacts, (C) recommend communication template if retention SLA breach observed.

alex_support: I logged action items in the ticket. I'll keep the customer updated hourly. Thanks all, will post back with IdP trace and billing reply. :thumbsup:
